newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power Colstrip 4 seen up by Tues.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power Colstrip 4 seen up by Tues.

text.p: Montana Power Co said Monday the 700 megawatt Colstrip 4 coal-fired power unit, which was shut Thursday for unplanned maintenance, will be back on line by early Tuesday.
"Testing is underway now. We expect the unit to begin operating this afternoon and to be back on line no later than 0800 MDT (1000 EDT) tomorrow," said company spokesman Dean Conklin.
The unit was taken off line for repairs to a generator part and had been expected to return to service late Sunday.
